title: Crash in `vkCreateDevice` of `RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::_initialize_device`
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 
- Godot_v3.5.2-stable_win64
- Godot_v4.0-stable_win64
- Godot_v4.6-beta1_win64
- `master` a0375dde960ee9dba46d461e0145123609691950

### System information

Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - all renderers - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8108) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads) - 63.74 GiB memory

### Issue description

When I used the "Reveal in File Explorer" option in the resource browser in the Godot editor, the Windows Explorer window would open, but then immediately close.

When I ran my game, the game would crash immediately. I was using the d3d12 driver with the Forward+ renderer.

When I restarted the editor a few times, the project selector also started crashing.

I debugged it the project selector crash with `master` a0375dde960ee9dba46d461e0145123609691950 to get the crash log:

### Steps to reproduce

- No idea.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A

### Solution

I was able to resolve this issue by:
1. Open the Windows Device Manager
2. Right click on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti and choose Disable device
3. Right click on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti and choose Enable device

After doing these steps, all problems were resolved, including the Windows Explorer window closing after revealing it through Godot.
